column4: dialect-gated (cleat#3552, B3b-2b): in a PostgreSQL-only job the SQL Server subtest and the MySQL test skip, and the PostgreSQL subtest RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: .../mssql and the MySQL test), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. The MySQL test asserts a refusal that is not "not found", so it has nothing to run on the other two.
